paragraphs.text: Cards from Hour of Devastation compared to cards from earlier sets .
Abrade is strictly better than Shatter .
Aerial Guide is strictly better than Wind Drake .
Aven of Enduring Hope is strictly better than Aven Battle Priest .
Bitterbow Sharpshooters is strictly better than Sentinel Spider .
Brambleweft Behemoth is strictly better than Kessig Dire Swine .
Consign // Oblivion is strictly better than Disperse .
Countervailing Winds is strictly better than Rakshasa's Disdain .
Dagger of the Worthy is strictly better than Torch Gauntlet .
Desert's Hold is strictly better than Arrest .
Djeru's Renunciation is strictly better than Lead Astray .
Dunes of the Dead is strictly better than Gods' Eye, Gate to the Reikai .
God-Pharaoh's Faithful is strictly better than Yoked Ox .
Graven Abomination is strictly better than Wicker Witch .
Hour of Glory is strictly better than Final Reward .
Hour of Revelation is strictly better than Planar Cleansing .
Jace's Defeat is strictly better than Gainsay .
Oketra's Avenger is strictly better than Blade of the Sixth Pride , Devilthorn Fox , Dromoka Warrior and Oreskos Swiftclaw .
Ominous Sphinx is strictly better than Air Elemental .
Doomfall is strictly better than Night Terrors .
Proven Combatant is strictly better than Fugitive Wizard , Merfolk of the Pearl Trident and Wandering Ones .
Refuse // Cooperate is strictly better than Parallectric Feedback .
Seer Of The Last Tomorrow is strictly better than Horned Turtle .
Spellweaver Eternal is strictly better than Umara Entangler .
Struggle // Survive is strictly better than Seismic Strike .
Tragic Lesson is strictly better than Catalog .
Unconventional Tactics is strictly better than Angelic Blessing .
Wander in Death is strictly better than Morbid Plunder .
Ambuscade is strictly worse than Clear Shot .
Carrion Screecher is strictly worse than Wake of Vultures .
Frilled Sandwalla is strictly worse than Basking Rootwalla .
Open Fire is strictly worse than Brimstone Volley , Lightning Bolt , Lightning Strike , Puncture Blast , Searing Spear , and Urza's Rage .
Dutiful Servants is strictly better than Pillarfield Ox , Foot Soldiers , and Great Hart , but strictly worse than Inquisitor's Ox , Salt Road Patrol , and Armory Guard .

Defiant Khenra is strictly better than Barbarian Outcast , Goblin Piker , Reckless Cohort , Goblin Bully , Goblin Elite Infantry , Goblin Firebug , Goblin Furrier , Goblin Hero , Goblin Mime , Goblin Raider , Gray Ogre , Hulking Goblin , Independent Troops , Ironclaw Orcs , Mad Dog , Mogg Jailer , Mogg Toady , Raging Bull , Sell-Sword Brute , Smoldering Efreet , and Goblin Brigand , but strictly worse than Battlefield Scavenger and Harsh Mentor .
Dutiful Servants is a colorshifted version of Rotted Hulk (black to white), except for creature types.
Scrounger of Souls is a colorshifted version of Faithbearer Paladin (white to black), except for creature types.
